aboutHtml:
We're Tim and Kate Martin. We run STIHL SHOP Taupo to serve our community with quality outdoor power equipment and expert support. We stock the full range of STIHL chainsaws, trimmers, blowers, and lawn care equipment, and we service them all.

We don't just sell gear. We service what we sell, supply genuine STIHL parts, and give straight advice on which tool suits your job. Whether you're clearing land, maintaining a lifestyle block, or keeping your garden tidy, we help you get the right equipment and keep it running well.

Come in and talk to us. We're here Monday to Friday from 8am to 5pm, and Saturday mornings from 9am to 1pm.
